name: FWC Window Counter
description: Shows frame windows in game in real time (uses results from the FWC app)

enabled.name: Show window counter
enabled.description: Turn off to hide the panel, numbers and rings in game.

show-rings.name: Rings at click position
show-rings.description: Leave a colored ring and the window number where each click happened.

click-sounds.name: Click sounds
click-sounds.description: Plays a click sound on every press and release. To use your own sounds, put press.wav and release.wav in the mod config folder 'clicks'.

macro-play.name: Play macro (by this mod)
macro-play.description: Plays the macro in the mod config folder. Copy your Eclipse replay there and rename it to macro.gdr2 (240 TPS only). Do not use together with Eclipse playback.

macro-file.name: Macro file
macro-file.description: Pick the macro to play: an Eclipse replay (.gdr2, 240 TPS) or a macro.txt (also ones recorded by this mod with CBF). It is copied into the mod folder the next time you open a level. 'Play macro' must be on.

macro-record.name: Record macro (by this mod)
macro-record.description: Records your own play. When you beat the level it is saved as macro.txt (the old one is copied to macro_prev.txt). In practice mode, dying and continuing keeps the inputs up to the checkpoint. Turned off while 'Play macro' is on.

record-cbf.name: Between-frame inputs when recording
record-cbf.description: off: inputs are saved on ticks (240 per second). fwc: this mod places each input between ticks itself (1/8000 s), and the Click Between Frames mod is paused while you play. cbf-mod: keep the Click Between Frames mod on; the position inside the tick is estimated from how far the player moved.

count-windows.name: Count windows in game
count-windows.description: Needs 'Play macro'. When the level starts, the mod replays the macro without drawing and counts the frame window of every click, then shows the result.

count-cbf.name: Count at 8000 fps (CBF)
count-cbf.description: After finding the window in whole ticks, also searches inside the edge ticks in 1/8000 s steps (about 12 more tries per input, counting takes about twice as long). Results are shown with one decimal.

record-video.name: Record video
record-video.description: Needs 'Play macro'. Replays the macro from the start and records showcase.mp4 (1280x720, 60 fps, no sound) into the mod config folder. Needs ffmpeg_path.txt there.

record-intro.name: Intro screen in video
record-intro.description: Adds a 3 second intro (level name, title and the frame window legend) at the start of showcase.mp4.

intro-subtitle.name: Intro subtitle
intro-subtitle.description: Optional second line under the level name on the intro screen (for example a list placement). Leave empty to hide.
